text.A: **Denna policy gäller var du än befinner dig.** Vi följer brittisk dataskyddslagstiftning, och där dataskyddslagstiftningen i det land där du bor också gäller, följer vi även den.
text.B: **Anteckningar om allergier och kost.** Vi för dem vidare till foodtrucken tillsammans med din beställning och använder dem inte till något annat. Vi tar bort dem, tillsammans med ditt namn och dina kontaktuppgifter, 12 månader efter beställningen (se avsnitt 7).
text.C: **Internationella överföringar.** Dina kontouppgifter och beställningsuppgifter lagras och behandlas i Storbritannien. Vissa saker hanteras utanför Storbritannien: menyutläsning och automatiska svar på WhatsApp, som använder en tjänst från Google i USA; leverans av WhatsApp-meddelanden, som hanteras av Meta i USA; betalningar, som hanteras av Stripe i USA; och pushnotiser, som levereras av Apple och Google i USA. När uppgifter lämnar Storbritannien omfattas överföringen av brittiska föreskrifter om adekvat skyddsnivå (UK adequacy regulations) eller av International Data Transfer Agreement eller Addendum och, där lagen i ditt land kräver det, av en skyddsåtgärd som den lagen erkänner. Du kan be oss om uppgifter om vilka skyddsåtgärder som gäller.
text.G:
Våra [Användarvillkor](/terms) gäller i alla länder där HatchGrab används. Vissa länder har ytterligare regler. Denna sida beskriver dem, ett land i taget.

När ett avsnitt nedan gäller för dig utgör det en del av våra Användarvillkor. Om det anger något annat än de gör, gäller denna sida för det landet.

Om ditt land inte finns med finns det inga ytterligare regler: Användarvillkoren gäller som de är skrivna. Vår [Integritetspolicy](/privacy) är densamma i alla länder.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We follow British data protection legislation, and where the data protection legislation of the country where you live also applies, we follow that too.
back.B: **Notes about allergies and diet.** We pass them on to the food truck together with your order and use them for nothing else. We remove them, together with your name and your contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: When data leave the UK, the transfer is covered by British regulations on adequate level of protection (UK adequacy regulations) or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum and, where the law of your country requires it, by a safeguard that that law recognises.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under British data protection legislation, and the law of the country where you live when it is applicable, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law where you live may give you these rights under other names, or additional rights. Those you have too. / **Making a request.** Email privacy@hatchgrab.com. We check that the request is genuine before we act on it. You can ask someone else to make the request for you, and we do not treat you differently because you make a request. We reply within one month, or earlier if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request on to that food truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to review it again by replying to our response. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove the operator's customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the law where you live allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Every email states who it is from, contains our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we do, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by SMS, you receive them only if you consent, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a personal data breach concerning your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we notify you and the supervisory authority as soon as we can where the law requires it, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Let us know first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would appreciate the chance to put the matter right. You can also complain to the data protection authority where you live. In the UK that is the Information Commissioner's Office, at ico.org.uk or on phone 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Use] apply in all countries where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have extra rules. This page describes them, one country at a time. / When a section below applies to you, it forms part of our Terms of Use. If it states something different from what they do, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no extra rules: the Terms of Use apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy] is the same in all countries.
